title: Karbala ke Dasht
body:
karbala ke dasht mein ek la-makaan aabaad hai
noor e haq aur maalik e kaun o makaan aabaad hai
<<DIVIDER>>
haathon pe asghar ko le kar keh rahe hai ye hussain
ek tabassum se tere ye do jahan aabaad hai
karbala ke dasht mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa mere akbar ke mit­'te ja rahe hai naqsh e paa
bas dam e ruqsat ka aankhon mein samaa aabaad hai
karbala ke dasht mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
dukhtare zahra tera mamnoon hai deen e khuda
shaam ke har mod pe tera bayan aabaad hai
karbala ke dasht mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
roz e ashoora ke dhalte hi udaasi dekhlo
aaj bhi shaam e ghariban ka dhuan aabaad hai
karbala ke dasht mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
abh raza kuch aur kya maange dar e lajpaal se
dil mein jab shabbir ki aah o fughan aabaad hai
karbala ke dasht mein...
author: Ali Raza
